data.body_html:
Easter 2025 falls on 18-21 April, and Marbella is one of the best places in Spain to celebrate with a boat trip. With daytime temperatures averaging 18-22°C and around 8 hours of sun, it's perfect for cruising the Costa del Sol. This guide covers April weather, sea conditions, and practical tips for booking your Marbella boat rental this Easter.

April Weather in Marbella: What to Expect

April is a transitional month – you'll get warm sunny days but also the chance of a light shower. Average highs reach 21°C, with lows around 12°C. The sea temperature is about 16°C, so swimming is for the brave, but the sun deck is always inviting. Easter week typically sees settled weather, but always check the forecast before heading out.

Why Rent a Boat at Easter in Marbella?

Easter is a vibrant time in Marbella, with processions, family gatherings, and the marina buzzing. A boat charter lets you escape the crowds and enjoy the coast from the water. You can anchor near Marbella's beaches, visit Cala del Faro, or cruise to Cabopino. The mild weather means you won't overheat, and the water is calm – ideal for a relaxed day out.

Best Routes for an April Cruise

From Puerto Banús, you can head east towards Cabopino or west to Estepona. In April, the sea is usually calm, so you can cover more distance. A classic 4-hour trip takes you past the Golden Mile, with views of La Concha. For a longer charter, go to Sotogrande – about 25 nautical miles – and spot dolphins along the way.

What to Pack for Your Easter Boat Trip

April's weather can change quickly, so pack layers: a light jacket, a warm fleece, and a t-shirt. Don't forget sunscreen (SPF 30+), sunglasses, and a hat. Non-slip deck shoes are recommended. Our boats have shaded areas, but the sun can still be strong – especially at midday.

Booking Tips for Easter Week

Easter is one of the busiest weeks in Marbella. Book your boat rental at least 4-6 weeks in advance, especially for the 18-21 April window. Weekend slots go fast. If you're flexible, a midweek charter often has more availability and better rates. Contact us via WhatsApp for personalised advice.
